paper.title_en: Grey-body factor from correspondence with quasinormal mode for gravitational perturbation of higher-dimensional Reissner-Nordström black hole
paper.abstract_en: We investigate the correspondence between quasinormal modes (QNMs) and grey-body factors (GBFs) of higher-dimensional Reissner-Nordström black holes. Considering gravitational perturbations of these black holes, we systematically compute the QNMs and GBFs for scalar, vector, and tensor perturbations, including the $(+)$ and $(-)$ types of scalar and vector perturbations, to examine the validity of the correspondence. The QNMs are computed using the continued fraction method, and the integration-through-midpoints method is applied when required by the singularity structure of the Frobenius series for each perturbation type and set of black-hole parameters. We evaluate the accuracy of the correspondence for each spacetime dimension $D$ and black-hole charge by comparing the GBFs obtained from the correspondence with those obtained by numerical integration. The correspondence provides a good approximation to the GBFs for the scalar($+$), vector($+$), vector($-$), and tensor perturbations. However, for the scalar($-$) type, the correspondence exhibits pronounced deviations at low to intermediate charges in $D > 6$. At higher charges, it recovers reasonable accuracy despite the effective potential exhibiting a double-peak structure inconsistent with the assumptions underlying the Wentzel-Kramers-Brillouin (WKB)-based derivation of the correspondence. In contrast to the other types, for which the correspondence deteriorates as $D$ increases, the scalar($-$) type is more accurate in $D=8$ than in $D=7$. Furthermore, the correspondence performs well for the vector($-$) perturbation of near-extreme black holes, even though the potential develops a double-peak structure in $D>6$. These results indicate that the correspondence is applicable over a broader range than expected from the assumptions of the WKB approximation.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文直接研究引力扰动、准正规模与灰体因子的对应关系，属于广义相对论基础中的黑洞扰动理论，理论深度与方法学信号明确，摘要对偏差与适用范围有清晰表述，值得点击阅读。
decision.title_zh: 高维Reissner-Nordström黑洞引力扰动中准正规模与灰体因子的对应关系
decision.abstract_zh: 我们研究了高维Reissner-Nordström黑洞的准正规模（QNMs）与灰体因子（GBFs）之间的对应关系。考虑这些黑洞的引力扰动，我们系统地计算了标量、矢量和张量扰动的QNMs和GBFs，其中包括标量和矢量扰动的$(+)$和$(-)$类型，以检验该对应关系的有效性。QNMs使用连分数方法计算，并在每种扰动类型和黑洞参数集的Frobenius级数的奇点结构需要时，应用中点积分方法。我们通过将对应关系得到的GBFs与数值积分得到的GBFs进行比较，评估了该对应关系对每个时空维度$D$和黑洞电荷的准确性。该对应关系为标量($+$)、矢量($+$)、矢量($-$)和张量扰动提供了良好的GBFs近似。然而，对于标量($-$)类型，该对应关系在$D > 6$的低到中等电荷下表现出显著偏差。在较高电荷下，尽管有效势呈现出与Wentzel-Kramers-Brillouin（WKB）推导该对应关系所基于的假设不一致的双峰结构，该对应关系仍恢复了合理的精度。与其他类型随着$D$增加对应关系变差不同，标量($-$)类型在$D=8$时比在$D=7$时更准确。此外，对于近极端黑洞的矢量($-$)扰动，该对应关系表现良好，即使在$D>6$时势能形成双峰结构。这些结果表明，该对应关系的适用范围比WKB近似假设所预期的更广。
